scope: Named Cast Lock 的权威角色数据。每个 T1 部位登记唯一允许写法 + 禁止写法，供 scripts/check_character_lock.py 做全文机器比对。
_comment: 这是身份块正文的唯一副本。character-consistency-protocol.md 只做索引，不复制正文 —— 两处各写一份就是下一次漂移的源头。identity_blocks 里的字符串必须逐字复制进提示词，禁止同义替换。
always_on_negatives: no readable text or logos on clothing

identity_blocks.full: Jake Miller, a 38-year-old white American male contractor, 185cm tall, broad-shouldered and solidly built, with sun-reddened weathered skin, a square jaw, a neatly trimmed light-brown short beard, grey-blue eyes, and short light-brown hair showing under a dark-grey baseball cap. He wears a faded olive-green work jacket, a charcoal-grey T-shirt, brown canvas utility trousers, dark-brown leather work boots, and yellow leather gloves. His movements are steady and powerful, reading as a real independent American contractor.

cast.assistant_lock: plain dark clothing, no cap, clean-shaven, visibly shorter
cast.negative_list_full: No hardhat, no hi-vis vest, no sunglasses, no visible tattoos, no jewelry, no readable text or logos on clothing, no change of jacket colour, no beard length change, no second person resembling him, no face distortion, no extra fingers.
